crossRefs.note: How precious is your loving kindness, God! The children of men take refuge under the shadow of your wings.
They shall be abundantly satisfied with the abundance of your house. You will make them drink of the river of your…
Because your loving kindness is better than life, my lips shall praise you.
Blessed is the one whom you choose and cause to come near, that he may live in your courts. We will be filled with the…
who forgives all your sins, who heals all your diseases,
Yahweh says: “A voice is heard in Ramah, lamentation and bitter weeping, Rachel weeping for her children. She refuses…
For how great is his goodness, and how great is his beauty! Grain will make the young men flourish, and new wine the…
Surely goodness and loving kindness shall follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in Yahweh’s house forever.
Won’t you revive us again, that your people may rejoice in you?
Bring joy to the soul of your servant, for to you, Lord, do I lift up my soul.
Let Israel rejoice in him who made them. Let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.
Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”

translations.web: Satisfy us in the morning with your loving kindness, that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
translations.bsb: Satisfy us in the morning with Your loving devotion, that we may sing for joy and be glad all our days.
translations.kjv: O satisfy us early with thy mercy; that we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
translations.asv: Oh satisfy us in the morning with thy lovingkindness, That we may rejoice and be glad all our days.
